description: This file defines a React component called JsonTable that renders nested JSON data as a table. It handles objects, arrays, and primitive values, with support for collapsible sections and customizable styling. The component is used to visualize JSON data structures in a tabular format.

methods.name: isPlainObject
methods.description: Type guard function that checks if a value is a plain object (not null, not array).

methods.name: safeStringify
methods.description: Safely converts a value to JSON string, returning a string even if errors occur.

methods.name: primitivePreview
methods.description: Returns a string preview of a primitive or complex value, handling null, undefined, strings, numbers, booleans, and objects.

methods.name: unionKeysForObjectArray
methods.description: Generates a list of unique keys from an array of object items.

methods.name: tableShellStyle
methods.description: CSS styles applied to the outer container of the JSON table.

methods.name: tableStyle
methods.description: Function returning CSS styles for the table element with a specified minimum width.

methods.name: headerCellStyle
methods.description: CSS styles for table header cells, including sticky positioning.

methods.name: bodyCellStyle
methods.description: CSS styles for table body cells.

methods.name: rowBgFor
methods.description: Function to determine row background color based on index for zebra striping.
